tldr: North Node in taurus: growth through stability, embodiment, self-worth, and simple values.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop stability, embodiment, self-worth, and simple values. The South Node in scorpio shows the familiar route: crisis bonding, intensity, control, and living through other people's resources or emergencies. The work is not to reject the South Node completely, but to stop letting it run automatically. The North Node becomes stronger through repeated, conscious choices to choose peace without mistaking it for passivity.
business: Growth accelerates when the person practices stability, embodiment, self-worth, and simple values in real decisions, relationships, work, and daily habits.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in scorpio can pull the person back into crisis bonding, intensity, control, and living through other people's resources or emergencies.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node sign names the growth medicine; South Node sign names the familiar pattern. Do not treat either node as a planet or deterministic fate.
note: Distilled from approved project node source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
